env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd subtoml
env CGO_ENABLED=0
logos build .
! logos build -o $WORK/subbin$GOEXE ./sub
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

[cgo] cd roottoml
[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build .
[cgo] logos build -o $WORK/subbin$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] exec $WORK/subbin$GOEXE
[cgo] stdout '^sub ok 42$'
cd ..

-- subtoml/go.mod --
module example.com/subt

go 1.27

-- subtoml/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("root") }

-- subtoml/sub/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- subtoml/sub/c.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("sub ok", C.answer()) }

-- roottoml/go.mod --

[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- roottoml/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("root") }

-- roottoml/sub/c.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

func main() { fmt.Println("sub ok", C.answer()) }
